items.headline: Will Henderson III, Michael Petro help UTSA hold off Rice 16-14 in American Conference opener
items.description: — Will Henderson III had a touchdown run and Michael Petro kicked three field goals to help UTSA hold off Rice 16-14 on Saturday night in an American Conference opener for both teams.

items.headline: Owen McCown passes for 303 yards and 3 TDs as UTSA beats Colorado State 59-45
items.description: — Owen McCown passed for 303 yards and three touchdowns, Will Henderson III and Brandon High Jr. each rushed for a score, and UTSA beat Colorado State 59-45 on Saturday.
